plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch covariate
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a single gene-level raw count matrix from salmon (12,000 genes x 12 samples, gene symbols in the first column) with a sample table carrying condition (6 treated, 6 control) and batch (two processing batches, each holding both conditions). The design is balanced and unconfounded, so the correct handling of batch is a fixed-effect design term (~ batch + condition) rather than any pre-adjustment of the counts — adjusting counts and then testing them inflates confidence. The plan is therefore: (T1S1) sample-structure QC on a blind VST — PCA on the top 500 variable genes coloured by both condition and batch, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes — which is what tells us whether batch or condition drives the primary axis and whether any of the 12 samples is an outlier, before a model is fitted; (T1S2) minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, ~ batch + condition with control set explicitly as the reference level, Wald test on the condition_treated_vs_control coefficient, apeglm shrinkage for reported/ranked fold changes, BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, plus a p-value histogram diagnostic; (T1S3) an independent edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same counts and the same design as a robustness check, since with 6 per group the two tools agree on most but not all genes and the intersection is the defensible high-confidence set; (T2S1) fgsea preranked GSEA on the full ranked list of tested genes using the DESeq2 Wald statistic as the ranking metric (the disputed choice is stated: Wald stat, because it scales the effect by its uncertainty and does not saturate into ties), against human MSigDB Hallmark first and Reactome second, both present in the reference store; (T1S4) a consolidated report with the two fit diagnostics, both shrunken and unshrunken log2 fold changes, the method-overlap counts, leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record. Note on power and scale: 6 vs 6 on 12,000 genes is a reasonable but not large experiment — if the DE list is short (fewer than ~50 genes at padj<0.05) the ranked enrichment is the only defensible functional read-out and no over-representation test should be run. The gene identifiers are symbols, so the enrichment step must map to the collection's identifier space and report the unmapped share.

steps.description: Assemble the final report from T1S1-T1S3 and T2S1. Include: the MA plot and the dispersion plot as the two fit diagnostics, before the gene tables; the p-value histogram; the gene table carrying unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value; a volcano plot; the DESeq2/edgeR significant-gene counts and intersection size with the intersection named as the high-confidence set; the enrichment section stating the collection and version, the Wald-statistic ranking metric, the tested-gene universe, the 15-500 size window, the tool version, the BH adjustment, and the leading-edge genes per significant set. Record the design formula ~ batch + condition, the contrast (condition, treated, control), the alpha of 0.05, the number of genes tested after filtering out of 12,000, the number of DE genes, sessionInfo with every package version, the random seeds, and the gene set collection versions. State plainly whether batch or condition dominated the sample structure in T1S1, and state the power limitation of 6 vs 6.
steps.context: Final synthesis for a 12-sample human kidney bulk RNA-seq experiment with a balanced two-batch structure.
acceptance_criteria: MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables, each with a one-line statement of what it shows
Gene table contains unshrunken log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange (estimator named) and lfcSE, and is ranked by the shrunken value
Method, package versions, design formula, contrast, thresholds, number of genes tested after filtering, and number of DE genes are all stated
DESeq2 / edgeR counts and intersection size are reported, with the intersection named as the high-confidence set
Enrichment section states database, version, ranking metric, universe, size window and multiple-testing method, and lists leading-edge genes per significant set
Reproducibility record (sessionInfo, seeds, package versions, collection versions) is stored with the results
The report states the method-dependence caveat for enrichment and the power limitation of a 6 vs 6 design
constraints: Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change; keep the p-values from the unshrunken fit
Do not present the union of the two DE methods as the result
Do not overstate: if the DE list is short or the p-value histogram is irregular, say so in the headline rather than in a footnote
caveats: The enrichment result depends on the method and the collection; a set is a hypothesis for follow-up
No external validation cohort is part of this analysis — findings are internal to these 12 samples

grounding.reason: Report contents follow the returned report step: fit diagnostics (R-0087), shrunken and unshrunken effects (R-0085), method/version/design/threshold reporting (R-0041, R-0051), method-overlap (R-0042), leading edge (R-0105) and the reproducibility record (R-0086).
